steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Th-there are two enemies left!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: They're running toward the building to our east--

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: I've already locked on to them.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Argh...!

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Bullseye.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Aren't we making too much noise?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: There are a ton of explosions all over the city. I don't think they'll notice.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Have you notified Dr. Kal'tsit yet?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I called her before the battle started.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: There's evidence that Reunion is conducting their operations in this city.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I haven't hung up yet.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Shouldn't we be a bit stealthier with our movements?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: That Reunion member just now seemed to be using Detection-type Arts.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: We'll have to strike first so that we don't give away our location.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: At least, we can't give these Reunion squads time to communicate with each other.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Phew... It's finally over...

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Frostleaf, assess the situation.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Here, hold on to the comms device.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Jessica, don't let your guard down yet.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Of course... I'm aware of that!

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: All right, all right. I won't mention it again.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, can you hear me?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Always could. Indeed, you can't afford to let your guard down yet.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Jessica, there might be an enemy behind you.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Uwaaah!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: H-how did they... get behind me...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...Eeehh??

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: If I can attack you from behind, that means you were too slow.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: We're fine for now, Dr. Kal'tsit. I've taken out the enemy.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: You really are fast...

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: I couldn't even see how you managed to get over there and come back so quickly.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: --Actually, I never even left.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Projekt Red contacted me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There are no signs of activity from the Reunion forces hiding in Lungmen.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: At this stage, it'd be best not to poke the hornet's nest.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: By the way, according to the intel I've received from the other recon teams, there may a fairly substantial Reunion presence in the desert.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: In other words, we're the ones who hit the jackpot?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: That does put a bit of pressure on us. We're also only a recon team after all.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: If that's the case, we've already eliminated two Reunion squads so far...

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Are you absolutely sure about the affiliation of the enemies we first exchanged fire with, Jessica?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Yeah, there shouldn't be any mistake. I double checked before asking you to shoot.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: ...My bad. I was busy calculating the ballistic trajectory.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What about the enemy's numbers?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: We don't know the exact number.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Frostleaf, how's it going over there?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: What's the matter...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Go take care of it. Let me know right away if there's an issue.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Will do.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Let's... head over to her to see what's going on.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...You two didn't feel it?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Huh? What...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: The temperature.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Now that you mentioned it... it does seem colder...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: The temperature.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: ...Indeed. There's at least a five-degree difference compared to the temperature outside.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: How could such fair weather... change so suddenly...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Look above you. The weather hasn't changed.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: It's not the weather.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: It's coming from here. Come, feel this.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: ...The walls of the ruins?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: That's right. These walls are heat-absorbing.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...No way?!

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Before we came, the heat absorption had probably already worn off.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: It's returning to the previous temperature.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: But, why?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Who would leave behind something like this?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: ...Reunion are the only ones who've been active in these parts.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Reunion? Could they... do something like this?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: The Infected...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I once heard of a certain legend.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...about a creature called the 'yeti.'

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: ...I have a feeling... that this is going to get real troublesome...
